column_description: TEXT. Unique site code identifier for archeologys zone. PK = Sites(ZoneRegistry). Example: SC9016.
TEXT. Descriptive name of the archeologys site. Example: Site-North Alexanderville.
TEXT. Excavation unit designation within the site. Example: Unit-C9.
TEXT. Grid reference system coordinates for site location. Example: S29-E8.
TEXT. Cultural period or chronological phase classification. **NULL means cultural period classification is undetermined or analysis incomplete.**. Example: Iron Age.
TEXT. Estimated date or age of archeologys materials. Example: -2929 BCE.
TEXT. Classification of archeologys site type. **NULL means site type classification is pending or cannot be determined.**. Example: Bur..
TEXT. Weather protection measures in place at site. **NULL means weather protection assessment not completed or not applicable.**. Possible values: Permanent, Temporary.

Fields: {"Depth_C":"REAL. Excavation depth below surface in centimeters. Example: 329.9.","Geo_X":"REAL. Latitude coordinate in decimal degrees. Example: -9.602135.","Geo_Y":"REAL. Fields: {"Entry_Stat":"TEXT. Site accessibility status for personnel and equipment. Possible values: Closed, Open, Restricted.","Env_Haz":"TEXT. Environmental risk factors present at the site.
